text:
lara: quick thread — should we keep the spend breakdown as a stacked card (org > projects inside) or split into two panels with a sticky org header? screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/spend-layout-v3.png
sam: i sketched both. stacked feels denser but makes top-to-bottom scanning easier. split panels give more room for token breakdown per-project though
josh: +1 to split for large orgs. stacked collapses too deep once you have 20 projects.
maria: copy nit — amount labels in the stacked view read like balances not consumption. can we change `Total spend` -> `Total consumption (USD)` and `Tokens` -> `Estimated tokens`?
lara: good call on copy. also accessibility: contrast on the teal sparkline is failing a11y check, @a11y-bot flagged 2.7:1
a11y-bot: automated check: accent-teal-400 on white ratio=2.6:1. recommend teal-600 or add 1px dark stroke to meet 3:1. Also keyboard focus missing for project rows when collapsed.
eduardo: for the split panels, what's the mobile flow? If we split, we need a single toggle that persists per user (org vs project-first)
sam: mobile idea — collapse into one column, with a sticky top toolbar that contains a segmented control: [Org view] [Project view]. persists in local storage.
josh: engineering constraints: analytics expects a single API for the main spend panel. splitting into two independent panels doubles calls unless we reuse the same payload and let client-side render variations. prefer single payload + render option.
maria: UX question — where does invoice download live? current prototype shows it in the org header. if we split, should invoice still be org-level CTA or in the billing drawer?
lara: prefer invoice stay in org header (makes sense for org admins). but we should add an affordance in the project row menu: `View related invoices` that links to filtered invoice list.
a11y-bot: microcopy: `Download invoice` button needs aria-label="Download invoice for {orgName}, {month}" for clarity to screen readers.
eduardo: perf note — if we show token breakdown per project with sparklines, consider lazy-rendering the charts on scroll to avoid initial paint jank.
sam: visual tweak suggestion — instead of full stacked bars, use horizontal mini-bars + numeric sparkline to save vertical space. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/mini-bars.png
josh: decision proposal: single API payload, UI-level toggle persisted, invoice primary CTA in org header + project-level link, change copy per maria, bump accent colors for a11y, lazy-render project charts. who wants to own the prototype updates?
maria: i can own the prototype updates this sprint and will push copy + a11y checklist to Figma.
eduardo: i'll file a tiny perf ticket for lazy-render and tag eng-runtime for guidance.
lara: ok let's do that. action items: 1) maria updates prototype + copy 2) eduardo files perf ticket 3) josh to scope API reuse for split rendering 4) sam to update visuals and color tokens for contrast. aim: ship to staging next week. :rocket:
sam: noted. will also add a toggle state in the design system tokens page.
josh: tagging eng-team for heads-up in #eng-platform.
lara: thanks everyone — keeping thread open for any follow-ups. if no objections i'll mark as decision and put into roadmap. :+1:
